text: 4.04 Advance Authorisation Applicant shall file application online in ANF 4A. Same form is applicable where Standard Input Output Norms (SION) have been notified or on the basis of adhoc norms or on self-declaration basis as per paragraph 4.07 of Handbook of Procedures.
